jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Platform
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About the role**

Rippling’s Professional Services team is responsible for ensuring customers see incredible business transformations by maximizing the value of our core Platform- including custom workflows, advanced reports/analytics, permission profiles, and approvals. Professional Services engagements are consultative and customized based on the customers’ unique needs/pain points.

The ideal candidate is a customer advocate, product advocate, and natural problem solver. *This role specifically, is technical. A candidate who is strong in Excel/ SQL and is curious about technology and platforms will succeed.*

### **What you will do**

* Ensure our customers are set up for success with our core platform:
* + Discover our customers' business needs and priorities
  + Solution customer’s business needs/priorities via workflows, reports, permissions and approvals
  + Build custom workflows, formula fields (requires you to build queries in RQL), advanced reports, permission profiles, and approvals
  + Train customers on the core platform
* Deliver to key KPI’s: project completions, CSAT, and adoption/exit gate adherence
* Work cross-functionally with CX, product, and marketing to maximize product adoption.
* + Design and document new use cases for our platform.
  + Train our internal and external teams through webinars
  + Contribute to our knowledge base and serve as a subject matter expert on the Platform
* Actively contribute to the development of new Platform features
* + Coordinate with product and engineering teams to support new use cases.
  + Assist with user testing and beta programs for new features.

### **What you will need**

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in professional services, implementation, or customer success
* + An ability to build relationships with customers
  + An ability to manage a book of business and control the customer’s implementation experience
  + A curiosity for product/technology
* *Strong preference*
* + *Experience writing your own SQL queries*
  + *Prior experience working at an HR/IT SaaS company*
* Ruthless prioritization and time management
* Strong attention to detail and ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Boundless energy to help other teams and your customers...all with a “can-do” attitude!
* Flexible to scaling and changing organizations and responsibilities
* Experience working with product and engineering teams to build and launch new products or features

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

---------------------

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Stockton/Modesto
jobs.description:
IXL Learning, a global edtech leader with personalized learning products used by millions of students worldwide, is seeking an Implementation Specialist to join our Professional Learning team and support mid-size districts in California.

At IXL Learning, professional learning is more than delivering training; it's about partnering with educators to transform teaching and learning in their classrooms, schools, and districts. As an Implementation Specialist, you will support mid-size districts to ensure a successful IXL implementation. You'll serve as a reliable partner and IXL expert, sharing practical strategies for using IXL to advance their district initiatives, delivering high-quality professional development, leading data reviews, and supporting strategic planning. Through your work, you'll help districts move from adoption to consistent, effective use of IXL that drives student growth.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, highly organized, instructional leader who thrives in a collaborative, high-energy environment. The ideal candidate is a polished communicator and engaging presenter with experience in instructional coaching or school leadership, and is excited to travel to support districts throughout California. #LI-REMOTE

This is a full-time remote position for candidates living in the Stockton or Modesto greater metro areas.#LI-EM1

#### **WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Partner with district leaders to provide implementation support to mid-size districts #LI-SCFO
* Collaborate with school and district partners to create and implement a professional development plan that supports a successful IXL implementation
* Travel regionally to support assigned districts, including facilitating in-person professional development and conducting quarterly visits —up to 60% possible travel during back-to-school season and up to 40% the remainder of the year
* Deliver high-quality live and virtual professional development sessions to drive engagement and usage of IXL
* Analyze and use data to drive decision-making and strategize next steps
* Partner with the Sales team to effectively manage and grow customer relationships, including supporting districts piloting IXL and other pre-sales opportunities

#### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* BA/BS degree
* 5+ years of experience teaching in a K-12 setting; instructional coaching, school leadership, or edtech PD experience strongly preferred
* 2+ years of experience providing professional development
* Experience supporting district implementations strongly preferred
* Exceptional presentation skills; comfortable presenting to teachers and administrators
* Excellent interpersonal skills—dynamic, enthusiastic, upbeat individual who connects well with others and has a positive, collaborative attitude
* Organized, methodical, and detail-oriented; ability to prioritize and effectively manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently, from start to finish
* Self-starter and quick learner with a passion for improving education through technology
* Strategic thinker and problem-solver
* Must live close to a major airport

*The base salary range for this full-time position is $75,000 to $90,000 +* *potential bonus eligibility* *+ benefits.* *Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for the position. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*

IXL Learning is the country's largest EdTech company. We reach millions of learners through our diverse range of products. For example:

* 1 in 3 students in the United States uses IXL.com
* Rosetta Stone provides an immersive learning experience for 25 languages
* Wyzant is the nation's largest community of tutors, covering 300+ subjects
* Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) is a comprehensive marketplace for millions of educator-created resources

Our mission is to create innovative products that will make a real, positive difference for learners and educators and we're looking for passionate, mission-minded people to join us in achieving this goal. We have a unique culture at IXL that fosters collaboration and the open exchange of ideas. We value our team and treat one another with kindness and respect. We approach our work with passion, tenacity, and authenticity. We find it immensely satisfying to develop products that impact the lives of millions and we are eager to have you join our team.

jobs.title: Deployment Specialist
jobs.description:
**Who we're looking for**

Fieldwire is seeking a Deployment Specialist to join the Construction Success team and own the first chapter of the customer journey. As a Deployment Specialist, you will own customer onboarding, which we call a deployment. You will activate, train, and implement Fieldwire for customers who are just starting their Fieldwire journey, guiding them from kickoff to the end of deployment within the first three months of their contract.

We are looking for construction professionals who have experience using and deploying software to plan and manage construction projects. Our ideal candidate is highly organized, curious about our customers' businesses, and passionate about improving the construction industry. You will work alongside the Account Manager and Customer Success Manager to run flexible, well-planned deployments that show customers real value from the start and leave them with a clear plan for long-term success.

**What you'll be doing**

You'll use your experience as a construction professional to turn a signed contract into a successful Fieldwire rollout. As a Fieldwire product and training expert, you will learn each customer's business, goals, and workflows, and use that understanding to shape the structure of their deployment. You will execute most of the deployment, from kickoff through the end of deployment, while the Customer Success Manager supports workflow buildout alongside you for the customer's long-term success. No two deployments are the same, so you'll adapt your approach to each client's needs, keep every deployment moving, and show measurable progress along the way.

**A day in the life of XYZ will find you doing XYZ and frequently solving these types of problems:**

* Partnering with customers to understand how their teams work, and shaping each deployment around their goals so Fieldwire fits naturally into their day-to-day.
* Helping teams from the field to the office feel confident and excited to use Fieldwire, and keeping every deployment moving forward.
* Showing customers the value of Fieldwire early, and setting them up with a clear path for long-term success.

**The primary responsibilities for our next XYZ will be to:**

* Become a Fieldwire product expert and learn best practices for configuring and utilizing the platform.
* Understand client construction needs and current tech stack in order to seamlessly integrate Fieldwire into a company's day-to-day workflows.
* Build and maintain lasting relationships with Fieldwire clients.
* Conduct web-based training(s) and demonstrations to educate clients on Fieldwire.
* Own the deployment (onboarding) plan for each newly purchased account, including milestones, owners, and timelines, from kickoff through the end of deployment, typically within the first three months of the contract.
* Activate and implement Fieldwire for new customers, including kickoff, configuration, user and project setup, and integration activities.
* Learn each customer's business, goals, and workflows, and use that understanding to shape the structure of their deployment.
* Define success measures with the customer early, then track them and show progress and value throughout the deployment.
* Co-create a clear plan for long-term success with the Customer Success Manager and Account Manager, so the customer leaves the deployment knowing what comes next.
* Follow up consistently and follow through commitments, keeping customer stakeholders engaged and blockers cleared.
* Work cross-functionally with Support, Solutions Architects, and others as needed.
* Communicate deployment status clearly and escalate risks early.
* Create a successful internal handoff after the end of deployment, giving the Customer Success Manager and Account Manager the context, documentation, and success plan they need to continue the customer's journey.
* Capture lessons learned and help build repeatable deployment playbooks and templates.

**At Fieldwire, we're looking for our next XYZ to have the following skills and experiences**

* 3+ years of professional construction experience, preferably with a combination of field and office management roles, and/or 3+ years of ConTech experience, preferably with experience in technology implementation.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Self-motivated and highly organized, with strong time management skills
* Diplomacy and patience when working through customer issues
* Comfortable communicating with anyone, from foreman to senior-level managers
* A basic understanding of construction process from design to completion
* An understanding of how all the different parties on a construction project interact and how they work with each other to drive a successful schedule/budget

Most go-to-market teams are still running playbooks built for a different era. More cold outreach. More ads. More noise. Crossbeam was built on a different idea: the fastest path to revenue is often through the companies already connected to your customers.

Crossbeam is the platform that makes that possible. Companies use Crossbeam to securely compare CRM data with partners, revealing shared customers, overlapping prospects, and warm paths into deals. As an Implementation Specialist on our Enterprise team, you will own the implementation journey for our largest customers (3,500+ employees), from contract close to the day their core use cases are live, and you will stay their technical advisor for the length of their contract. You will work hand in hand with Account Success Managers (ASMs), Account Executives, and our Business Development team to turn a signed contract into a long-term partnership.

Your work is organized around 5 pillars.

* Pre-kickoff & Scoping:

* Join internal handover calls with Account Executives before (or right at) contract close, so customers never feel like discovery is starting over
* Run a client readiness review and a data governance checklist upfront: CRM setup, integration user, SSO, security requirements, internal resources and key deadlines
* Co-lead the kickoff with the ASM: present the implementation plan, timeline, and ownership

* Use-Case-First Implementation & Project Management:

* Partner with the ASM to run a strategy session that aligns on the customer's top use cases, KPIs, and priority partners, then build the implementation plan around them (not around a feature checklist)
* Run weekly working sessions with the customer's RevOps, Partnerships, and IT stakeholders, and deliver a technical go-live within a 90-day target
* Lead the technical rollout across three phases:

  + In-app and CRM setup: sandbox testing (Salesforce, HubSpot), data sources, populations, sharing settings, SSO, and user management
  + Operationalizing partner data: account mapping, report notifications, and integrations with the customer's tech stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, Slack, Copilot, Clay, Snowflake, Gong, MCP and more)
  + Ecosystem growth: partner activation alongside our Business Development team
* Document progress, risks, and decisions in our customer success platform, and flag onboarding risk early so you can act on it together with the ASM

* Enablement & Partner Workshops:

* Run partner workshops that help customers and their partners build collaborative routines using Crossbeam reports, shared lists, and notifications
* Teach customers to be self-sufficient with our Help Center and Academy, and set expectations on how to engage Support and their ASM going forward

* Hand off to the ASM with a clear picture of what's live, what's next, and where the opportunities are

* Spot expansion signals and scope Professional Services engagements (custom configurations, technical rework, extra enablement or workshops) when needs go beyond standard scope

* Help build and refine our Enterprise implementation processes, templates, and AI-powered workflows, and share best practices with the team

**What you'll need:**

* 2+ years in implementation or onboarding at a B2B SaaS company
* 1+ year in a customer-facing role
* Experience running technical implementations end to end, with strong project management
* Hands-on experience configuring a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot) and its integrations
* A consultative, solution-oriented mindset
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication

**It’s a bonus if you have:**

* Experience working with Enterprise customers (3,500+ employees)
* Microsoft Dynamics experience
* Familiarity with MCP and AI tooling

**You'll do great if you:**

* Lead with outcomes, not features. You ask "what is this customer trying to achieve?" before deciding what to configure
* Are comfortable in the room with both a Salesforce admin and a VP of Partnerships, and adjust your message to each
* Protect quality. You set realistic expectations and push back (kindly and clearly) when a timeline or scope puts the customer at risk
* See every implementation call as a chance to drive adoption, reduce risk, and surface the next opportunity
* Take ownership without waiting for permission, and keep multi-stakeholder projects moving when priorities shift
* Dig until you understand the real problem, not just the surface request
* Use AI to synthesize information, prep sessions, and move faster, while knowing when a human touch matters most
* Like building the playbook as much as running it. Our Enterprise motion is evolving, and your input will shape it

**You'll get:**

* Competitive compensation and equity
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your family

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Onboarding Specialist**

**COREWARE | JOB DESCRIPTION**

Department: Customer Success – Onboarding

Reports to: Implementation & Onboarding Lead

Role focus: End-to-end customer onboarding, launch readiness, training, adoption, and time to value

**Position Summary**

The Onboarding Specialist owns the customer onboarding journey from kickoff through successful launch and handoff. This role guides customers through discovery, account setup, configuration, data readiness, training, testing, and activation of their purchased Coreware solutions. The goal is to help customers go live quickly and correctly, confidently use their essential workflows, and realize value with minimal avoidable post-launch issues. The Onboarding Specialist is accountable for the onboarding outcome—not simply completing tasks or scheduling activities. The Onboarding Specialist executes Coreware’s prescribed onboarding playbooks and uses available product capabilities, standardized workflows, and automation to deliver consistent, high-quality onboarding across the appropriate service levels.

**End-to-End Customer Onboarding Ownership**

* Own assigned customer onboarding journeys from kickoff through successful go-live and transition to ongoing support.
* Create and drive clear onboarding plans, milestones, timelines, customer responsibilities, and success criteria.
* Guide customers through account setup, configuration, applicable data migration, integrations, training, testing, and launch preparation.
* Serve as the customer’s primary onboarding contact; proactively resolve blockers and escalate risks.
* Ensure purchased solutions in the agreed onboarding scope are ready for use; keep customer records and milestones current.

**Onboarding Quality & Launch Readiness**

* Understand customer goals and business workflows, and translate them into accurate, usable Coreware setup.
* Verify that required settings, integrations, applicable data, and critical workflows work as expected before launch.
* Lead readiness checks and hands-on testing to identify and resolve gaps before customers begin live operations.
* Confirm customer teams, workflows, and purchased capabilities are ready for launch; document readiness and open items.
* Prevent avoidable setup issues, confusion, and support escalations after go-live.

**Customer Training & Adoption**

* Deliver practical, role-based onboarding and training for purchased products and day-to-day workflows.
* Tailor guidance to each customer’s operations, team roles, and level of experience.
* Validate learning through demonstrations, practice, and successful completion of key workflows.
* Identify adoption barriers early and provide targeted coaching and resources before launch.
* Ensure customer users can perform essential tasks independently and confidently at go-live.

**Time to Value & Onboarding Efficiency**

* Move customers toward their first meaningful value from Coreware as quickly as practical.
* Actively manage outstanding customer actions, dependencies, and internal support to prevent avoidable delays.
* Apply the prescribed onboarding process consistently while maintaining quality and adapting to customer needs.
* Prioritize the setup, training, and workflows customers need to begin benefiting from their purchased solutions.
* Balance onboarding speed with accurate setup, strong training, and sustainable customer adoption.

**Standardized Onboarding & Process Efficiency**

* Execute onboarding in accordance with Coreware’s prescribed playbooks, processes, and service models, including self-guided, guided, and managed approaches as they are introduced.
* Adjust customer engagement and hands-on assistance to the assigned onboarding approach while maintaining accountability for launch readiness, customer adoption, and onboarding quality.
* Use available product functionality, onboarding tools, automation, and standardized workflows to reduce manual work and accelerate time to value.
* Follow established onboarding milestones, quality standards, training requirements, and launch-readiness checks consistently.
* Identify recurring friction and recommend improvements to playbooks, self-service resources, and product-enabled onboarding efficiencies.

**Customer Communication & Experience**

* Lead onboarding kickoff, progress, training, and launch-readiness conversations with clear next steps.
* Set expectations for timelines, responsibilities, required customer actions, risks, and changes.
* Build customer confidence through proactive guidance, responsiveness, and ownership of the onboarding experience.

**Customer Risk Management, Expectation Setting & Issue Resolution**

* Proactively identify and mitigate onboarding risks, including customer concerns, scope changes, configuration challenges, unmet expectations, and potential delays to go-live.
* Set clear expectations about current product capabilities, agreed onboarding scope, timelines, and the difference between essential launch requirements and future enhancements.
* Guide customers toward existing Coreware functionality, standard workflows, and practical alternatives that meet business needs without unnecessary customization or delay.
* Address objections and de-escalate customer concerns through active listening, clear communication, and solution-oriented recommendations.
* Maintain forward momentum by constructively challenging avoidable delays, reinforcing milestones, and helping customers make informed launch decisions.
* Advocate for legitimate, business-critical customer needs while preventing nonessential enhancement requests from unnecessarily stalling onboarding.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership to evaluate genuine product gaps and escalate critical blockers; do not promise unapproved enhancements or delivery dates.
* Use sound judgment to determine when to recommend current functionality, adjust a workflow, escalate a blocker, or revise an onboarding plan.

**Go-Live Handoff & Continuous Improvement**

* Document customer goals, account setup, training completion, launch status, outstanding items, and known risks.
* Provide a structured handoff to Customer Success and Support, and help resolve onboarding-related early-life issues.
* Review early customer usage and recurring friction to improve onboarding playbooks, readiness checks, and training.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**KPI**

**Measurement**

Time to Value (TTV)

Time from onboarding kickoff to the customer’s first meaningful value from purchased solutions.

Time to Go-Live

Elapsed time from onboarding kickoff to successful production launch, measured against targets.

Onboarding Quality / First-Time-Right

Share of launches without significant preventable setup errors, missing requirements, or readiness gaps.

On-Time Go-Live Rate

Share of customers launched by agreed target dates, accounting for documented dependencies and scope changes.

Post-Launch Onboarding Issue Rate

Onboarding-related support requests, setup problems, or escalations within 30 days of launch.

Customer Adoption & Readiness

Demonstrated ability to use essential workflows and purchased functionality at launch.

Training Effectiveness

Required training completed and customer proficiency demonstrated.

Onboarding Milestone Completion

Timely completion and accurate documentation of onboarding milestones and readiness checks.

Onboarding Satisfaction

Customer feedback on onboarding guidance, communication, training, and launch experience.

Onboarding Productivity

Customers successfully onboarded relative to workload and complexity without sacrificing quality.

Onboarding Risk & Escalation Management

Effectiveness in identifying and resolving risks early, managing customer expectations, and minimizing avoidable delays while escalating genuine launch blockers appropriately.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience in SaaS customer onboarding, software implementation, customer enablement, or a related customer-facing role.
* Ability to independently own multiple customer onboarding journeys from kickoff through successful launch.
* Strong project organization, customer communication, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.
* Experience training software users and translating business needs into effective platform setup.
* Ability to collaborate across Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering.
* Experience with onboarding or project tracking tools; familiarity with Coreware products and customer industries is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Customers complete onboarding efficiently and confidently: their purchased solutions are set up correctly, essential workflows work, and users are trained to operate independently. Successful onboarding means a fast, high-quality launch, early product adoption, and few preventable post-launch issues.

Pay: $25.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager (Captain of Go-Live)
jobs.description:
Do you feel more in your element, not less, when a project has six stakeholders, three departments, and a deadline that actually matters to someone's budget? Can you read an RFP or a draft SOW and spot the commitment that will blow up month four of an implementation before anyone has signed anything? Do you get more satisfaction from watching your team land a go-live than from landing it yourself? Can you spot a risk quietly building across two different workstreams, or across five people's portfolios, before anyone else notices it? Do you already reach for AI to move faster through complex data and document work, and coach your team to do the same? Are you the person other teams call when an enterprise account needs someone steady at the helm? If so, keep reading...

The team at RTA is looking for an Implementation Manager: our Enterprise Orchestrator, Team Coach, and Fleet360 Authority all rolled into one. Reporting to the CTO, you'll lead RTA's implementation team of enterprise and non-enterprise Implementation Specialists. You'll own the delivery of every customer onboarding from signed contract through a confident go-live.

You'll hire, coach, and hold accountable the specialists who run every engagement, and step in as the escalation point when an enterprise account needs a steady hand. Your work starts before the contract is signed. You'll partner with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process to review RFPs, SOWs, and contract language, so that what we promise is something we can actually deliver. You'll coordinate across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM (Customer Success Management), catch risk across the whole portfolio before it threatens a timeline, and make sure every customer arrives at go-live confident, not just converted. This position plays a direct role in RTA's mission to help fleets succeed, starting with the customers who trust us with the most.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

In general, someone who:

* Feels at home being a member of a healthy team. This means they aren't afraid to mix it up or be held accountable by the team, and they are willing to hold others accountable as well. People with trust issues and insecurity need not apply. No, seriously.
* Passionately cares about our clients and helping them be more successful. Our clients are fleet managers, parts clerks, and automotive technicians who maintain everything from squad cars to school buses so that everyone comes home safely at the end of the day.
* Thinks of themselves less, while not thinking less of themselves. They are other-centric, compassionate, and self-assured.
* Is willing to lift boxes, clean floors, and hold doors if that's what it takes to get something done, because no job is beneath them.
* Takes ownership and initiative. They identify how to make processes better without waiting to be told, and practice Extreme Ownership when things go sideways.
* Loves to read, learn, grow, and stretch themselves through goal setting and daily habits. Bonus points for each book you've read by Patrick Lencioni.
* Wants to be part of a leadership team that constantly challenges and stretches each other's abilities. We don't do echo chambers here.

**Specifically for This Role, Someone Who:**
--------------------------------------------

**Leads and develops the team**

* Has led and managed an implementation, onboarding, or professional services team for a software product, and loves helping others excel in their work.
* Sets clear expectations, runs effective 1:1s, gives direct feedback early, and creates a culture where people grow and do their best work. Part coach, part bulldozer: you seek and destroy the obstacles blocking your team.
* Holds specialists accountable to timelines, quality, and scope, and has the hard conversation when performance isn't there, rather than quietly absorbing the work yourself.
* Recruits, onboards, and retains strong implementers, and builds onboarding plans that get new specialists running implementations on their own quickly.
* Balances workload across the team: assigns new engagements based on capacity and complexity, and sees an overloaded portfolio before it becomes a missed go-live.
* Understands the value of metrics, knows what to track and how to track it, and makes staffing, process, and tooling decisions from the data.

**Reviews enterprise documents before the deal is signed**

* Partners with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process, reviewing RFPs, SOWs, contracts, and statements of requirements for implementation scope, timeline, data migration, integration, and staffing commitments.
* Reads requirement language line by line and flags anything vague, unrealistic, or out of scope, then proposes the language that fixes it before it becomes a commitment we have to keep.
* Contributes the implementation sections of RFP responses and SOWs: approach, timeline, roles, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.
* Turns the signed documents into the implementation plan, so the team delivers against what was actually contracted, not what someone remembers from the sales call.

**Owns enterprise delivery**

* Owns timeline and sequencing across the team's full implementation portfolio.
* Coordinates explicitly across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM at defined handoff points, keeping every team's commitments visible instead of assumed.
* Proactively surfaces risk, including cross-departmental dependencies that are quietly stalling, and brings a mitigation plan instead of just a flag.
* Guides customers, including senior fleet and operations leaders, through high-stakes configuration decisions with enough credibility that they trust your judgment, not just your process.
* Builds confidence with enterprise customers by communicating proactively, setting clear expectations, and creating trust long before issues ever arise. You are the escalation point when a customer relationship gets tense.
* Holds the agreed scope line with customers, knowing when a variation needs documentation, an addendum, or a real escalation, and coaches the team to do the same.
* Owns data migration quality across the team. You can clean, compile, and migrate data into Fleet360 yourself, and you're comfortable with nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks. You also set the standard and review the work so migration errors don't reach go-live.
* Builds and refines implementation processes, playbooks, and templates that scale as the enterprise pipeline grows.
* Operates with an AI-first mindset and makes the team AI-first too: using AI to speed up document review, data analysis, customer communication, and project execution, while knowing exactly when human judgment is required. This one is not optional here.

RTA's biggest customers carry the most people, the most vehicles, and the most on the line if something falls through the cracks. You're the one making sure your whole team holds it together, from the first RFP question to the last go-live checklist item. Are you the reason it comes together instead of falling apart? Let's find out.

**This Role Probably Is Not for You if...**
-------------------------------------------

* You want to manage from a dashboard. You'll be in the RFPs, the escalation calls, and the data reviews alongside your team.
* You'd rather be the best implementer than build a team of them. Your success is measured by the team's go-lives, not your own.
* You avoid hard conversations. Holding a specialist accountable, or telling Sales that an RFP commitment isn't deliverable, is part of the job.
* You think contracts and RFPs are Sales' problem. If you'd rather find out what we promised at kickoff, this isn't your role.
* You want one team and one clear lane. This role coordinates Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM across every engagement, often all at once.
* You wait for someone else to flag risk. If a dependency or a specialist's portfolio is quietly stalling, naming it and building the mitigation plan is your job.
* You treat scope creep as a later problem. On accounts this size, an undocumented variation can turn into real financial or timeline exposure fast.
* You think using AI is cutting corners, or you're waiting for someone else to figure out how it fits your job. At RTA, that's not a personality quirk. It's a mismatch with the role.

**Key Results Areas (aka the Job Outcomes)**
--------------------------------------------

* Hit the agreed go-live date on at least 90% of the team's engagements each quarter, with at-risk timelines surfaced with a mitigation plan at least 2 weeks before they slip.
* Review 100% of enterprise RFPs, SOWs, and contracts for implementation commitments before submission or signature, returning comments to Sales within 3 business days.
* Zero signed enterprise commitments for implementation scope, timeline, or staffing that the team can't deliver as written.
* Maintain a customer satisfaction rating of 90% or higher across the team's completed implementations each quarter.
* Zero downstream data-quality escalations traced back to migration error, across the team.
* Log 100% of customer scope variations in the account record, escalating any that require an addendum within 2 business days of identification.
* Achieve 95% completion of internal implementation milestones on or before committed dates, so downstream teams receive clean, complete handoffs.
* Build and retain a high-performing team: low regrettable attrition, a documented development plan for every specialist, and new hires running implementations on their own within 90 days.
* Put at least one new AI-assisted workflow into practice across the team each quarter that measurably speeds up document review, data work, customer communication, or troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**
------------------

OK, the boring HR part of the job posting that looks like every other posting out there, but it's necessary:

* 7+ years in customer-facing implementation, onboarding, professional services, or project management roles; B2B SaaS (Software as a Service) strongly preferred
* 2+ years directly managing people, ideally a team of 4 or more implementers, consultants, or project managers
* Hands-on experience reviewing RFPs, SOWs, MSAs (Master Service Agreements), or similar contract documents for delivery scope and risk; public sector procurement experience a strong plus
* Track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations from kickoff through go-live
* Proficient with Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with comfort in nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks
* Experience with project/ticket tracking tools (e.g., JIRA) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tools (e.g., HubSpot)
* Comfortable leading conversations with senior fleet and operations leaders, including high-stakes configuration decisions and scope pushback
* Demonstrated, real-world use of AI tools to increase speed or accuracy in your own work and your team's, with specific examples you can speak to
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you write clearly enough that your redlines and comments don't need a follow-up meeting
* Fleet, fleet-adjacent, or public sector operations experience preferred, not required. We define this broadly:  
  + Direct fleet or asset operations: fleet manager, shop supervisor, maintenance coordinator, or municipal, school, and EMS fleet operations
  + Fleet-adjacent industries: transportation and logistics, public works, construction or utilities equipment, waste management
  + Fleet-adjacent software: implementation or onboarding experience with other fleet, asset, or maintenance management platforms
* Exposure to SQL (Structured Query Language) or structured databases preferred, not required
* Bachelor's degree not required. Relevant experience and breadth of knowledge matter more

Nick Fury never threw a punch. He assembled the team, coordinated the moving parts, and made sure everyone showed up in the right place at the right time. Think you can do that for an entire implementation team? Prove it.

**The Bottom Line**
-------------------

You've made it this far, congratulations. We're looking for an ideal team player with an almost frightening intensity around orchestration, credibility, and follow-through. That means someone who can build a team that holds six-team engagements together without losing sight of a single open item, and who catches the bad commitment in the RFP before it ever reaches the team. If you feel a quiet thrill when a complicated account lands exactly where it's supposed to, on time and without drama, and even more when your team lands it, we want to talk.

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

* Total compensation for this role is between $120,000 and $135,000 based on experience.
* This is a full-time, fully remote-eligible role, including for candidates based in the Phoenix metro area.
* First week onboarding onsite at RTA HQ in Glendale, AZ required.
* Occasional visits to RTA HQ for team events should be expected.
* Travel to customer sites for pre-sales meetings, kickoffs, and go-lives is up to 10% annually, based on business needs.
* This position is classified as exempt and is not eligible for overtime pay.

**Why Top Talent Chooses RTA**
------------------------------

We invest in our people — period.

* 401(k) with 6% Safe Harbor match (100% vested day one)
* Flexible PTO model built on trust and manager-approved time off
* Cigna PPO and HSA medical plan options with company contributions ($780–$1,950 annually)
* Garner Health HRA program: up to $1,000 individual / $2,000 family reimbursement opportunity
* Wellness rewards up to $350 annually
* Virtual care and mental health support resources
* Company-sponsored benefits including dental, vision, EAP, life, STD, LTD, legal plan, and identity theft protection options
* Additional employee perks, wellness initiatives, and discount programs

**The Part We're Most Proud Of**
--------------------------------

* 99% of employees say RTA is a Great Place to Work® (Certified 3 years running)
* 30% ARR growth — two years straight
* We are an AI-forward company building for the future
* We see you. You have been reading this for seven minutes. Just apply already.

The EHR Application Principal Trainer - Pharmacist is an Information Technology role responsible for designing, developing, validating, maintaining, and delivering role-based application training for assigned electronic health record (EHR) and healthcare information system applications. * Develop and maintain application curriculum: • Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve role-based application training curriculum, lesson plans, workflow scenarios, tip sheets, job aids, exercises, eLearning content, and supporting materials for assigned EHR and healthcare information system applications, addressing all phases of medication management and closed-loop medication processes.

jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident & health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs.
  
  
Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state-of-the-art technology.
  
  
EVV Training Specialist
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
The Agency-Level EVV Training Specialist will be responsible for planning, developing, coordinating, and delivering training programs for Operations teams. The role requires a strong understanding of operational processes, systems, and business requirements, along with the ability to develop effective learning solutions that enhance employee knowledge, skills, and overall operational performance.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities:**  
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:**  
**Includes the following:**  
Plan and deliver instructor-led training sessions for Operations teams, covering soft skills, system-related functionalities, operational processes, and domain-specific knowledge.
  
  
Assist in the creation, review, and maintenance of training materials and learning artifacts, including presentations, training guides, handouts, knowledge assessments, and other supporting documentation.
  
  
Partner with Operations leadership to identify skill gaps and emerging training requirements and develop appropriate training interventions to address them in a timely and effective manner.
  
  
Ensure assigned and scheduled training programs are delivered within established timelines. Monitor trainee participation and completion to ensure adherence to training requirements.
  
  
Collect and analyze trainee feedback following each training session. Identify opportunities to improve training content, curriculum, and delivery methods to enhance learning effectiveness and knowledge retention.
  
  
Participate in discussions and collaborate with the Capgemini Learning & Development (L&D) team, as required, to align training initiatives, share best practices, and support organizational learning objectives.
  
  
Periodically review and analyze Operations QA scores to identify recurring errors, knowledge gaps, and performance improvement opportunities. Develop and recommend targeted training plans to address identified gaps.
  
  
Maintain accurate records and trackers for all Soft Skills, Operational, System, and Mandatory training programs conducted for Operations teams, including participation and completion status.
  
  
Support the review, development, and periodic updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documents, and other operational reference materials to ensure alignment with current business practices.
  
  
Provide inputs and recommendations for designing and implementing new training approaches, methodologies, and learning frameworks, particularly for large-scale projects and new operational transitions.
  
  
Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.
  
  
**Required Skills/Abilities:**  
Time/Task Management
  
  
Attention to detail
  
  
Strong communicating and presentation skill
  
  
Ability to guide, mentor, and support trainees
  
  
Analytical problem-solving capabilities
  
  
Experience in developing others through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing
  
  
Ability to establish and maintain effective stakeholder relationships
  
  
Confidence in interacting with leadership
  
  
Ability to foster a collaborative and continuous learning environment
  
  
Awareness of relevant technologies, systems, and digital learning tools
  
  
Willingness to adopt new tools, platforms, and technology-enabled learning methodologies.
  
  
Industry knowledge and understanding the importance and benefits of Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) for LTCIs, Claimants, Providers, Caregivers (Customer Base)
  
  
Effective communication and transfer of knowledge to EVV program to Customer Base
  
  
**Education and Experience:**  
Demonstrated understanding or experience in adult learning principles, training methodologies, and knowledge transfer, with a strong willingness and aptitude to learn new operational processes, systems, and domain-specific concepts
  
  
Excellent verbal communication, public speaking, and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently facilitate and lead training sessions for large groups
  
  
Experience in designing, coordinating, and delivering corporate training programs is preferred.
  
  
Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to develop engaging and professional training presentations
  
  
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for maintaining training trackers, analyzing basic data, and monitoring training completion
  
  
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word for preparing and maintaining training materials, process documents, and other learning resources
  
  
Prior experience in the US Healthcare domain is preferred but not mandatory
  
  
Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to work extended hours, when required, to support business and training needs
  
  
Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and take on additional responsibilities or assignments as needed

jobs.description:
At WelbeHealth, each participant of our program is guided by our interdisciplinary team (IDT), composed of clinical and non-clinical members who work cohesively to provide all-inclusive care to our most vulnerable senior population.

The WelbeHealth Advocate Training Specialist will be accountable for facilitating training and support as needed. The WelbeHealth Advocate Training Specialist will serve as a subject matter expert in both operational processes and systems used by the Health Plan Services team, and will ensure that the comprehensive training program is inclusive of any additional systems training as applicable. The WelbeHealth Advocate Training Specialist will collaborate with their supervisor by providing feedback and ideas on improving training methods and the overall training experience to promote WelbeHealth values and team culture.

* Conduct both routine and ad-hoc trainings for the WelbeHealth Advocate Hub team
* Design role-based comprehensive curriculum and training plans using industry and training best practices, including both new hire programs and ongoing/ad-hoc training needs
* Develop process for evaluation of training and program effectiveness, and incorporate feedback into future design
* Conduct needs assessments and competency assessments for staff on a regular basis to identify skill or knowledge gaps that need to be addressed
* Identify learners who require additional support, and partners with supervisors to provide that additional support and teaching
* Partner with the Technology team to understand technology and system deployments or releases to understand team impact and assess training needs

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Must be able to commute to WelbeHealth centers monthly for onsite training
* Minimum of three (3) years of experience as a training specialist or in a similar role, with teaching, coaching, or developing training curriculum.
